run.name: TPG RE Finance Trust, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (TRTX)
run.summary: Asset quality looks stable but the cushions are narrowing: leverage rose to 4.03x and usable liquidity is thin. Confidence is moderate because covenant values, executed agreements and EBITDA are not available. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

cash.basis: Cash. 2026-09-30; secured credit agreements 87.317, secured revolver 22.000, Revolver 100.000 (10-Q Q3 page:105). Cash includes 52.6 held for liquidity covenants. Excludes 11.491 CLO reinvestment proceeds at the trustee. Contractual availability under the secured credit agreements is larger at 777.844 but depends on lender-approved collateral (page:47, page:91)

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant test values, executed agreements, EBITDA and the use of proceeds of the October 2026 CLO are not supplied, so headroom and post-quarter leverage cannot be measured.
CP-1 main limitation: No EBITDA is reported and covenant test values and executed agreements are not supplied, so coverage and covenant headroom cannot be measured.
